preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == line for line in stdin.strip().splitlines())
preconditions.description: No lines contain leading or trailing spaces.
The first line is an integer N between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The total number of lines is exactly N + 1 (header plus N commands).
Each command line has a length of at most 100 characters.
Each command line ends with a period.

preconditions.expression: all(' ' not in line or (line.split(' ')[0] == 'Simon' and line.split(' ')[1] == 'says' and len(line.split(' ')) > 2) or line.split(' ')[0] != 'Simon' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: If a line starts with 'Simon says', it must have at least one word after 'says'; otherwise, it does not start with 'Simon says'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join([line[10:] + '\n' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.startswith('Simon says ')])
postconditions.description: For every command line starting with 'Simon says ', the output contains the substring starting from the 11th character (index 10) followed by a newline; lines not starting with 'Simon says ' are ignored.
